reference.title: Kodak Ultramax manufacturer information and El Grafo’s first-hand GC 400 identification
reference.license: Manufacturer and specimen references linked for study. Procedural film lettering is original project artwork (ISC). See packaging README for bundled photograph licensing.
reference.limitations: KODAK GC 400 identification follows the photographed specimen’s first-hand description. Orange base, lettering placement, frame/half-frame cadence and color/grain look are artistic approximations, not calibrated sensitometry. Exact optical DX codes, batch IDs and production tolerances are unverified and omitted.
